Name: Slime Range
Author: archello11443
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Have you ever hatched a slime egg outdoors ?  With this mod, you may want to .[/color][/size]

[size=3][color=#D4D4D8][url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Slimes]Slimes[/url] are great !  They bear the wealth of the land, dropping all kinds of valuable resource :  metal ore (including iridium), coal, stone, wood, diamonds, prismatic shards, golden animal crackers, gift boxes, trinkets, etc. etc.[/color][/size]

[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]This mod does a few things to enhance the experience of slime ranching, with special attention to Cindersnap Forest .[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Slimes dissipate (are removed) in water[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Slimes can change color according to season, gradually and/or instantly upon removing debris . [/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Yes, slimes can now remove debris .  This applies to forage as well .  Each morning, they will check right next to them, and remove one debris or forage item .[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Slime population cap - You can limit the maximum number of slimes to prevent game lag .[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#d4d4d8](Cindersnap Forest only) [/color]
[list]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Insulated Southeast region - Slimes on the land below the river will not be affected by the seasons .[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Warded homes - Slimes will despawn when they are right in front of buildings (Leah's house and Marnie's ranch, the wizard tower, the raccoon home, and the travelling merchant's spot)[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#d4d4d8]All of these changes are applied to the slimes each morning .  If you want to apply this mod to locations beside Cindersnap Forest, you can write it in on the mod's config .  Most of these settings have configuration !  The most fun settings are probably customizing the slimes color for each season .  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] is highly recommended if you want to change these things easier .  And with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/541]Lookup Anything[/url] you can view exact information for each slime .[/color]

Maybe also check these mods out, I think they pair well with this one .  They will make it very easy to move through the forest, and with Passable Crops you can make "gates" that only the player can walk through .
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15223]Passable Crops[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34375]Push and Pull[/url][/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]SMAPI[/color][/size]
